investigation.found: The timesheet prints a total of 160.00 hours, but its daily hours add up to 152.00. One of the two is wrong, and nothing in the records says which.

proposals.what_to_do: If the daily hours are right, bill 152 hours.
proposals.why: The days are usually what the client approved.

proposals.what_to_do: If the printed total is right, bill 160 hours.
proposals.why: If a day is missing from the list.
